passives.name: YamamotoEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
On $Takedown within this unit's range:
- Transform the enemy into a $YamamotoSkeleton (Capacity: {1})
Each $YamamotoSkeleton will act as a $PathTrap:
- When touched by an enemy, deal {2}% of this unit's current damage
- Explode and apply $Fire to enemies within {3} range
Each $YamamotoSkeleton summoned will:
- Increase this unit's damage by {4}%
